Priya (AE): Hey team — Fintera sent a SIG + a short custom security questionnaire. They want answers by EOW Fri. Uploading files now.
IntakeBot: New questionnaire uploaded: fintera_SIG_2026.pdf (2.1 MB) and fintera_custom_questions.xlsx
Alex (Sales): @Riley can you pick this up? Key asks: they flagged 'Personal Data' and want encryption evidence + SOC2 scope.
Riley (Security): Assigned to me. Quick Q — is the PoC on Hosted API or Dedicated/private? That changes control evidence.
Priya (AE): PoC will be hosted initially, but customer is asking if Dedicated or Private is available later.
Jon (SE): We can offer Dedicated for final deployment. For PoC hosted is fine. SOC2 summary is available here (internal): https://redwood.internal/compliance/soc2-summary
Riley (Security): Good. I'll start mapping SIG to our standard answer set. Please upload the customer's filled spreadsheet to the shared drive and redact any PII.
Priya (AE): Uploaded redacted answers: https://drive.redwood/fintera/sig_answers_redacted.csv — removed user samples and client IDs.
Riley (Security): Reviewing now. Early notes: encryption-at-rest = YES (KMS-backed) — need the KMS config doc. Network separation = depends on Dedicated, flagged as "requires contract clause" for hosted. Marked 3 items as "requires legal".
Maya (Legal): Thanks @Riley, I'll review the contract clause language and DPA addendum. ETA tomorrow morning.
Alex (Sales): For the PoC they want SSO + short token retention. Can SE scope configuration to ensure tokens expire immediately after session?
Jon (SE): Yes — PoC can use ephemeral tokens and restrict scopes. Example config we use for PoC:
```
auth:
  token_ttl: 3600 # 1 hour
  ephemeral: true
  scopes: [read, generate]
```
Jon (SE): I'll attach the PoC runbook to the drive.
Riley (Security): I updated the SIG spreadsheet with tentative answers + evidence links (internal): https://drive.redwood/fintera/sig_answers_with_evidence.csv — added KMS export, SOC2 page, pen test summary. For a few questions I put "No — requires product change" and noted mitigations.
Priya (AE): Customer asked about pen-test cadence and whether we do client-specific tests. What should I say?
Riley (Security): We perform annual third-party pen tests; client-specific tests are on a case-by-case contractual basis. Added note and evidence link.
Jon (SE): On the product items flagged as "requires change" I can propose a config to reduce exposure (response redaction + param throttling). I'll paste a sample later.
Priya (AE): Perfect. Once Legal signs off on the DPA clause I'll send the spreadsheet back to the customer and mark status. Targeting to close this thread after Legal OK. :thumbsup:
Riley (Security): Status: in-review, assigned to Riley, awaiting Legal artifacts and KMS config. Target close ts: 1777777820.
Maya (Legal): I'll post updates in this thread after review.
Priya (AE): Thanks everyone — I’ll keep the customer updated and share the final doc when ready.
Riley (Security): Closing note: captured action items in the sheet and flagged one high-risk item for product follow-up. Will reopen if Legal requests changes. :white_check_mark:
